ibergeregg-sihlsee-muotathal-short-alpin.title: Ibergeregg · Sihlsee · Muotathal Short Alpine
ibergeregg-sihlsee-muotathal-short-alpin.slogan: Two passes and 96 km, high point 1406 m
ibergeregg-sihlsee-muotathal-short-alpin.story: Close, punchy and better than its distance suggests. 96 km round from Unterägeri - plan on about 1 h 50 of riding. On the way it passes Einsiedeln, Sihlsee water line and Muotathal valley. The climbs: Ratenpass warm-up and Ibergeregg pass road. It tops out at 1,406 m. Ibergeregg Pass is subject to seasonal closure - check it is open before you set off. The passes are the reason to go.

waypoints.name: Ratenpass warm-up
waypoints.advice: Ratenpass warm-up is the summit of this stretch at 1077 m. Reckon on about 3 °C colder than the valley, and more in the wind. Next is Einsiedeln coffee stop, mostly downhill.

waypoints.name: Ibergeregg pass road
waypoints.advice: Ibergeregg pass road tops the climb at 1406 m. The road climbs 796 m on the way up to it, hard. Reckon on about 5 °C colder than the valley, and more in the wind. Nothing on this route is higher. High enough to hold ice in the shaded corners early and late in the year. Next is Back to Ratenpass warm-up, mostly downhill.

ibergeregg-sihlsee-muotathal-short-alpin.speedBand: 40–70 km/h riding core, local limits always win

sections.advice: Ratenpass warm-up → Einsiedeln coffee stop is the reward section in Ibergeregg. Look through the bends, use legal pull-offs for photos and keep a little margin for tractors, cyclists and damp shade. The best ride here is smooth, not noisy.

This Sihlsee water line → Muotathal valley reset stretch is for rhythm and scenery. Keep your head up, let the view breathe, and resist turning every open bend into a target. Stop once properly rather than half-stopping everywhere.

scenicChapters.title: Lake Lucerne Axenstrasse
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 36 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go. Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Lake Lucerne Axenstrasse
scenicChapters.narrative: First and second gear more often than not. Look through each corner to the next one and let the engine do the holding. The valley floor is behind you and the road starts working for its height at about 10.9%. Corners stack above one another where the ground allows nothing straighter.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Lake Lucerne Axenstrasse
scenicChapters.narrative: For 29 km this is Lake Lucerne Axenstrasse, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it — expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.
